posts.title: FreeBSD on an OVH dedicated server
posts.description: I run FreeBSD on an OVH dedicated server. It took me a long time to get a setup that works well there, one small setting at a time. This post collects all of them. The install OVH no longer offers FreeBSD in its installation catalog, so you are on your own from the install. posts.title: Torrents through Mullvad on FreeBSD
posts.description: I run Transmission on FreeBSD. For privacy reasons, I do not want it to announce one of my public IP addresses to every peer of every torrent. The usual answer is to put the whole machine behind a VPN. I cannot do that: the other services of the server must answer on its public addresses. posts.title: Mail is not that hard
posts.description: I have hosted my own mail for frimin.fr since 2019, today on a single FreeBSD machine. Friends told me self-hosted mail is too hard. Setting it up takes some work, but running it takes almost none. I started after reading this post by Gilles Chehade, which convinced me to stop giving my mail to a big provider. My first setup followed his next post with OpenSMTPD, Dovecot and Rspamd. Thanks to him!
